correctness.rationale: For w=0^a1^b0^c1^d0^e with all positive, every palindrome has even number of run transitions, so the four transitions can be allocated to optimal factors by the exhaustive 0/2/4 internal-transition possibilities. Reconstructing cut placements gives the b=d special case, the unique two-part case c=a+e when b!=d, and the exactly three-part cases with q indicators. In the remaining c<min(a,e), b!=d regime, the only four-part cuts comprise c-1 internal zero splits and three fixed boundary types, giving K=c+2. For <=4 runs, direct transition classification bounds K<=2. Positive-run decomposition yields the exact rational GF 2z^8v^3/((1-z)^3(1-z^2)(1-z^3v)), sharp finite-length maximum 2+floor((n-5)/3) for n>=8, and, using convergence of uniform compositions to Dirichlet(1,1,1,1,1), density 4(1-3t)^3 on (0,1/3) with atom 2/3 at zero and E K_n=n/45+O(1). Independent palindrome DP verified 3125 positive quintuple instances, direct enumerative GF coefficients for n<=19; this is corroboration of a complete symbolic proof.
residual_risks: Finite DP and GF coefficient checks do not prove all positive integer cases, which rest on transition pairing.
